biotools.summary: CellDetail is an open-source 3D-cell-image analysis platform used to quantitatively determine the spatial distribution of components within cells, particularly focusing on polarity proteins and Septin networks.  It uses a dipole moment-based algorithm and has been used to analyze hematopoietic stem cells and human fibroblasts.
